caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped container with a yellow background. The surface of the container is decorated with a pattern of pink and white flowers with dark brown stems and branches, as well as green leaves. The flowers are spread evenly across the body of the container. There is a decorative pink and white border with floral motifs along both the top and bottom edges of the container. The lid appears slightly darker, mostly a muted greenish-brown color, and is bordered by a striped pattern in pink and white. The overall composition centers on the container against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or elements visible.
title: Bandbox
